ms.report:
Milestone 2: “Introduction to Impact Accounting” Course Development:
Outputs
This milestone has one output (deliverable): the “Introduction to Impact Account” course.
In order to deliver the “Introduction to Impact Account” course, we will conduct the following key activities:
・Curriculum Design: Develop a detailed syllabus covering key topics in impact accounting, such as ESG metrics, sustainability reporting standards, and stakeholder impact analysis.
・Contact Experts: Engage with domain experts on impact accounting so that they can advise on the curriculum and also participate in the video creation.
・Content Creation: Produce high-quality, engaging course materials, including lectures, case studies, interactive exercises, and assessments.
・Learning Management System Setup: Upload and set up the course materials such as videos, documents, exercises, and assessments on a Learning Management Platform.
・Issuance of Certificate of Completion using Atala PRISM DID: We’ll develop a capability to issue a certificate of completion of “Introduction to Impact Accounting” using an identity wallet connected to Atala PRISM v2.0.

Acceptance criteria
The deliverable ‘the “Introduction to Impact Account” course’ is considered “accepted” when it meets the following criteria:
・Curriculum: The curriculum gives an overview of why it is important to learn impact accounting (trends, impact on society, job prospects, etc.) and how we measure impact through different approaches such as Impact Weighted Accounts, ESG, and financial information disclosure obligations in different jurisdictions.
・Experts: Domain experts on impact accounting should advise and or participate in the video creation.
・Content: The videos should be produced by professionals. The course should be a mixture of video lectures, reading materials, interactive exercises, and assessments.
・Learning Management System: The videos, reading materials, exercises, and assessments are uploaded to a Learning Management Platform
